claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing repository benchmarks only check whether final patches pass tests, concealing where coding agents fail; intermediate ground truths enable diagnosing implicit requirement recovery as the main bottleneck and guide improvements in planning and code generation for iterative repository editing.
